# Local animation dependencies

The site uses local copies so the exhibition does not depend on a CDN at runtime.

- `three-r128.min.js`: three.js r128, MIT, downloaded from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`.
- `gsap-3.12.5.min.js`: GSAP 3.12.5, copyright and license notice retained in the distributed file, downloaded from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js`.

Versions follow the user-supplied Opaque Stack reference prompt. The fictional brand, stock image contact sheet, project names, and project descriptions from that prompt are not included; the exhibition uses Yuli Studio's existing project data and local artwork.
